summary: DigitalOcean Holdings filed an 8-K announcing an amendment to its existing credit agreement, increasing the revolving credit facility by $112.5 million and the letter of credit sublimit by $50 million. The amendment also redefines capitalized lease indebtedness at 25% of the capitalized amount. Proceeds are for working capital, capex, acquisitions, and refinancing. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
